candidates.clause_text: The expenses incurred during the investigation and defense of a claim are borne by us and do not reduce the available limits of liability.
candidates.state:
The employer must not interfere with our medical management strategies or attempt to direct the injured worker to unauthorized providers.
If the employer becomes aware of potential fraud or malingering, they must communicate this information to our investigative unit immediately.

We will participate in all mandatory mediation sessions, dispute resolution conferences, and administrative hearings on behalf of the enterprise.
Any administrative penalties levied due to our failure to pay benefits timely will be absorbed by us, unless the delay was caused by the employer.
